title: Lesson 26 - I Thought You Were Handling It

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Aisha, the permission log is still incomplete. I thought you were handling it.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I thought that was your part. I was supposed to prepare the visuals, but I understood “copy” to include the captions and permission notes.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I was writing the captions when Marcus sent the meeting summary. Maybe I read “visuals” too narrowly.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: And maybe I wasn't clear when I said the images were ready. I meant the layout was ready, not the records.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So we may have misunderstood each other. Let's check the note before we decide.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Here it is: “Daniel—copy and captions. Aisha—visuals and source files.” It doesn't name the permission log.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then the assignment wasn't complete. Let's fix it now. What still needs to be done?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Three records. I'll contact the image owners and update the log by two.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I'll do the final check by three and flag anything missing.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: So you're handling the final check, and I'm handling the three records, right?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Right. I'll also add both steps to the shared task list.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Good. I'll mark each record complete as soon as the owner replies.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then I won't start the final check until all three are marked.
